newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oakland, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF BOND SALE

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the BOROUGH OF OAKLAND, in the County of Bergen, New Jersey at the Borough of Oakland, Temporary Borough Hall, Basement of Valley Middle School, Municipal Plaza, Oakland, New Jersey on
until 11:00 a.m., for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Borough due on December 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one bond for the aggregate principal amount maturing in each year. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Lowenstein, Sandler, KohI, Fisher & BoyIan, P.A.

The Bonds will bear interest at a rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on June 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on first days of December and June in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the Notice of Sale. The Bonds of this issue are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities.
The Bonds are subject to the requirements of SEC Rule 15c2-12 with respect to secondary market disclosure.
The Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting the Chief Financial Officer at the Borough of Oakland, Municipal Plaza, Oakland, New Jersey 07436, (201)337-8111.
